question: I99
title: text1000 guard: does the granule pathway's learned gain cost short text? v43 / v44 / v44 granGain 0.001 / 0.01 on text1000, 48 fresh growths k 2464-2511

accept.note: y175: v43 vs v41 text1000 -0.0011 (11/33, t -2.4, n 48); v44 adds -0.0003 (n.s.). The gain psi (granGain = its learning rate) should silence the granule pathway when it does not help; on 1000 symbols it may move too slowly (0.01) or overshoot (0.001). A setting that recovers >= +0.0008 on text without costing book10k / fables (y180b) is a text fix.
